findings.summary: ChangeDeliveryTypeModal renders without error; `deliveryTypeLabel` resolves from the global mixin
findings.detail: The brief for L-MODAL-BROKEN-TWO reported this modal as throwing on render for a missing label helper. plugins/global-mixin.js:97 defines deliveryTypeLabel and nuxt.config.js:189 registers the mixin (ssr:false, and this surface is inside AdminPage's <client-only>), so the helper is on every component. `git log -S` puts it in the tree well before the modal was written. Nothing was repaired and nothing was deleted: the modal is reachable — OrderCard emits change-delivery, ongoing.vue mounts it, OrderService.ChangeDeliveryType PUTs /orders/change-delivery-type — and it works end to end, as these steps show.
